name: Senior Android Engineer vs FinTech Senior Mobile Role
job_description:
We are seeking a Senior Android Engineer to spearhead the evolution of our mobile financial platform. You will build highly responsive, crash-free customer experiences.

Key Requirements:
- 5+ years of production Android development experience using Kotlin and the Android SDK.
- Deep mastery of Jetpack Compose for state-driven declarative UI engineering.
- Strong command of Kotlin Coroutines, StateFlow, and SharedFlow for asynchronous reactive pipelines.
- Experience with dependency injection using Dagger Hilt.
- Expertise in local persistent storage using Room and network communication via Retrofit.
- Solid grounding in Clean Architecture and MVVM / MVI architectural patterns.
- Rigorous unit testing and UI testing discipline with JUnit and MockK.
- Familiarity with CI/CD automation pipelines and Gradle build scripting.

Nice-to-Have:
- Experience with GraphQL clients.
- Mobile observability with Datadog.

name: Senior Platform Engineer vs Cloud Platform SRE Role
job_description:
ScaleOps is hiring a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to architect and operate our next-generation multi-tenant cloud platform.

Responsibilities:
- Manage and scale enterprise production Kubernetes clusters across AWS.
- Author reusable, modular Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Helm.
- Build continuous delivery GitOps pipelines using ArgoCD and CI/CD tools.
- Implement end-to-end observability, metrics collection, and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager.
- Write infrastructure automation scripts in Python, Bash, and Linux systems programming.

Bonus Qualifications:
- Secrets governance with HashiCorp Vault.
- Service mesh orchestration with Istio.

name: Staff Java/Kafka Engineer vs Go Distributed Systems Role
job_description:
StreamPlatform Networks is looking for a Senior Distributed Systems Engineer to build ultra-low-latency message brokers and real-time streaming engines.

Requirements:
- 5+ years building distributed systems and high-throughput microservices.
- Extensive production experience with Golang, Goroutines, channels, and concurrency primitives.
- In-depth operational knowledge of Apache Kafka event streams, partitioning, and consumer lag.
- Experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and network socket programming.
- Strong proficiency with PostgreSQL and Redis caching layers.
- Experience orchestrating microservices in Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.

Nice to have:
- Background in JVM microservices (Java/Kotlin) or C++ is considered a transferrable plus.

name: Junior React Frontend Dev vs Full-Stack Web Developer Role
job_description:
SaaSStartup is looking for a full-stack engineer to build our customer portal.

Requirements:
- 2+ years of professional web development experience.
- Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Next.js.
- Modern styling using Tailwind CSS, responsive design, and CSS3.
- State management with Redux Toolkit or React Context.
- Server-side development with Node.js, Express, and REST APIs.
- Database modeling with PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
- Unit testing using Jest and React Testing Library.
- Containerization using Docker and cloud hosting on AWS.

name: Junior Frontend Developer vs Principal Embedded Firmware Engineer
job_description:
IoT Dynamics is seeking a Principal Embedded Firmware Engineer to lead bare-metal and RTOS firmware engineering for mission-critical satellite telemetry sensors.

Mandatory Qualifications:
- 8+ years hands-on development in Embedded C and modern C++.
- Experience with real-time operating systems (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or VxWorks).
- Microcontroller architectures: ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and bare-metal registers.
- Hardware serial protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN bus.
- Hands-on debugging with logic analyzers, digital oscilloscopes, and JTAG/SWD emulators.
- Hardware board bring-up, PCB schematic review, and low-power power management.
- Version control with Git.
